def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    closing_prices = [150, 152, 153, 150, 155, 157, 158, 160, 162, 161]
    period = 5
    smoothing_factor = 2 / (period + 1)

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    ema = sum(closing_prices[:period]) / period

    for price in closing_prices[period:]:
        ema = (price - ema) * smoothing_factor + ema

    answer = round(ema, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
